criticality: Author-selected necessary conditions for this limited joint claim; not universal ecological criticality

stock.definition: Spatial mean over fixed equivalent soil mass corresponding to nominal 0–30 cm

sediment.definition: Representative plot-outlet mass per area over complete concurrent window

conversion.definition: Fixed F; gross union of baseline-native locations converted at any time in [0,5], counted once

panel: Prespecified compatible contemporary mean; no causal counterfactual or recovery target
duplicates: Exact duplicates deduplicated; conflicting records halt
missingness: Explicit missing/ineligible records remain unknown with reasons
exact_zero: No tolerance; no rounding before sign classification
